guitar.evidence: Shawn Mendes is a singer-guitarist who often performs with Martin acoustic guitars, but no singularly iconic documented model and guitar is a secondary element to his pop production.

tone.target: bright clean pop rhythm with chorus delay sheen
tone.profile: bright clean pop rhythm with chorus delay sheen
tone.summary: A bright, clean signal chain utilizing a Fender-style amp and chorus/delay effects to capture the pop sheen of Shawn Mendes' rhythm playing.

rig.name: Shawn Mendes - Stitches Arr. Yehyia Ibrahim - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly lift the signal to ensure clarity and pop presence.
blocks.gap: The Boost pedal is used for general level adjustment, as a dedicated clean boost isn't specified. It helps maintain headroom.

alternatives.reason: Compression could also be used to even out dynamics.

blocks.purpose: Keep the signal clean and avoid any grit or breakup.
blocks.gap: The verdict explicitly avoids heavy fuzz/high gain. Keeping this module bypassed ensures maximum cleanliness.

blocks.purpose: Provide clean headroom and a bright, Fender-esque tone suitable for pop music.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best fit for 'clean combo' and 'single-coil' tones. Settings are dialed back to prevent breakup.

alternatives.reason: Also a good clean option, but US Deluxe often has a slightly brighter pop character.

blocks.purpose: Match the bright, clean character of the US Deluxe amp.
Enhance the clarity and 'pop' in the rhythm guitar tone.
blocks.gap: Used to sculpt the frequency response for maximum pop presence, compensating for potential muddiness from the amp/cab stack.

blocks.purpose: Bypass the wah pedal as it is not required for this pop rhythm style.
blocks.gap: The verdict does not call for a filter sweep or vocal effect.

blocks.purpose: Add the required 'chorus/vibrato' sheen and width to the rhythm tone.
Provide the 'tight delay' and rhythmic echo effect.
Add subtle space and depth without distracting from the pop clarity.
blocks.gap: The verdict suggests dropping reverb, but a small amount of Room is necessary for overall polish and glue.

alternatives.reason: A Plate could also work, offering a slightly more controlled decay.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for increased clarity and pop sheen.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, clean character needed for modern pop production.
